Patterns

PELE & AINA KAI


Paying homage to the love and respect for Hawaii’s natural elements. Pele, the Goddess of Fire, is captured in the bright color which adds an element of safety. While Aina (land) and Kai (sea) show the birds and mountains, fish and sea, flowing in unity. Together, these prints share the story of life created and encourages balance and fluidity for all.

MONSTERA


Showcases Taro and Palm leaves with Kauai’s fragrant Plumeria flower typically found on traditional Aloha shirts. Our Monstera Print is a celebration of Kauai’s abundance and the vast tropical beauty she encompasses.

HI’IAKA


“Waves of Water” summoned by Hi’iaka to calm the wildfires of her sistser Pele during a fued, celebrates the balance of forgivness & reconciliation. Our Hi’iaka print illustrates the delicate story of humanity and how living in harmony can only be obtained through mutual respect and understanding of one another which is yin & yang.
